page.layout: One column of running text, with three footnotes below it in smaller type. Running head at top left, page number at top right, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.l: quidquid petiisti, mitte de comitatu tuo
duos homines probos, timentes Deum;
veraces {l} Sapientes & intelligentes &
doctos, & vide, quid dixerit tibi anima tua, &
quod placuerit in oculis tuis ex aliquo
artificio pretioso. Mitte illud cum eis in
domum Dei Israel ad in scriptionem sa-
cram & ad nomen magnum, sacerdotes-
que magnos munus, votumque & sponta-
neam oblationem Prophetis sanctis El-
eazaro & Ithamar, & Phinees & Josuæ filio
Nun, & Calebo filio Jephone & Josepho
Patri nostro {m} filio fructificanti, super
quos pax in æternum, omnes enim
sepulti sunt in ditione urbis Sichem, defe-
runturq; ad eos vota & oblationes spon-
taneæ ex omni urbe & ex omnibus fami-
liis; hoc si feceris, cognoscemus, quod
Dominum timeas, & in eum credas, & in
Mosem Prophetam ejus, & in legem scri-
pturæ ejus, & quod ames populum ejus
filios Israel; accidet autem, si feceris,
quemadmodum dico, ut benedicat tibi
Dominus Deus tuus {n} Dabisque pecuniam

page.notes: The line ending "defe-runturq;" keeps the printed abbreviation q; (for -que). The running text runs on from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The footnote letters (l), (m), (n) are printed as parentheses in the text and are given here as curly-brace marks. Long s is printed as a plain s throughout. The signature "G 4" is slightly unclear in the scan.
